resource.name: StockSilo
resource.creator: Rampant Octopus Softworks
resource.description: Tracks stock-comp download origins and exports a CSV for licensing and relinking. Companion browser utility; it does not grant stock-media licenses. Firefox and Chrome list version 1.4.1. Release notes describe Chrome logging, permission and project-history fixes; browser capabilities differ.

evidence.note: Recorded version evidence, not installation testing.

Tracks stock-comp download origins and exports a CSV for later licensing and relinking. Companion browser utility; it does not grant stock-media licenses. Firefox 1.3.7 adds clickable CSV hyperlinks; Chrome remains 1.3.6 and also offers download-folder routing, which Firefox does not.
Updates the recorded browser-extension release to 1.4.1.

version.name: StockSilo
version.note: Original provider release/changelog reviewed. Catalogue review date is separate from the upstream release date.

history.name: StockSilo
history.summary: Updates the recorded browser-extension release to 1.4.1.
changes: Store notes describe corrected CSV naming and permission-request timing in Chrome.
Adds project recovery from Chrome download history and safeguards against overwriting incomplete logs.
Firefox publishes the same version and notes; do not assume all Chrome capabilities exist in Firefox.
